torch_wheel_check.windows_cp311_availability: Confirmed win_amd64 + cp311 wheels exist on download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
torch_wheel_check.expected_size_class: CPU-only wheels are the ~190-280MB class (vs. multi-GB CUDA builds) -- explicitly targeting the /whl/cpu index avoids ever resolving a CUDA wheel

decision.rationale: Disk is not a constraint. RAM is tight (3.15GB free) but T5-base (~220M params, ~880MB fp32 weights) should fit with margin; TinyLlama (1.1B, ~4.4GB fp32) will NOT fit in fp32 and must be loaded in fp16/bf16 (~2.2GB) if attempted at all, watched closely, only after T5 is proven stable.
decision.isolation: New venv at data/experiments/specialized_model_infra_20260901/venv (named literally 'venv' so the existing repo .gitignore rule excludes it automatically -- verified, no git noise). Production venv untouched.
decision.stack_rationale: torch/transformers: required to load either candidate. peft: required for TinyLlama's LoRA adapter (PeftModel.from_pretrained). accelerate: not strictly required for basic CPU inference, but enables low_cpu_mem_usage=True in from_pretrained, which avoids a double-memory-copy during model load -- directly serves the RAM guardrail. sentencepiece: required by T5's tokenizer (SentencePiece-based); included defensively for TinyLlama too even though it ships a fast tokenizer.json.
